title: Online Identification Can Replace a Floor-Plan Prior on Unseen Buildings
abstract: arXiv:2611.33656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Smart Buildings Challenge asks for one HVAC control policy that runs office buildings and weather it has never seen, from the building's metadata and sensor streams alone. Our controller sees no data from the target building before it runs and is not tuned per building; its few global constants were set on development scenarios. Each zone has a first-order grey-box model that starts from coefficients computed from the floor plan and is updated online by recursive least squares, and a planner and a closed-form mapping turn the models into plant commands. On two sets of buildings and weather that we generated, a validation set and a stress set with real-year weather, it scores 0.145 and 0.159 times the starter kit's PID baseline, and 0.095 times on a holdout built after all versions were fixed and scored once. translated_title: 在线辨识可替代平面图先验以应对未知建筑
translated_abstract: 智能建筑挑战赛要求一个统一的暖通空调（HVAC）控制策略，能够仅凭建筑元数据和传感器数据流，在从未见过的办公楼和天气条件下运行。我们的控制器在运行前不接触目标建筑的任何数据，也不针对单个建筑进行调优；其少量全局常数仅在开发场景中设定。每个区域采用一个一阶灰箱模型，其初始系数由平面图计算得出，随后通过递归最小二乘法在线更新；规划器和一个闭式映射将这些模型转化为设备指令。在我们生成的两组建筑与天气数据集（验证集以及采用真实年份天气的压力集）上，该方法得分分别为起始套件PID基线的0.145倍和0.159倍，而在所有版本冻结后构建、仅评分一次的保留集上得分为0.095倍。该方法在每栋建筑上均有所改进，也优于我们实现的两种ASHRAE Guideline 36版本：每组得分为0.60至0.71倍（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需目标建筑数据的暖通空调控制策略，用递归最小二乘法在线辨识一阶灰箱模型来替代平面图先验，在从未见过的建筑上性能大幅超越PID基线和ASHRAE Guideline 36。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an HVAC control policy requiring no target-building data, replacing a floor-plan prior with online recursive least-squares identification of first-order grey-box models, which substantially outperforms PID baselines and ASHRAE Guideline 36 on unseen buildings.
